lines: This is what happens inside Kairos, for
one borrower, on one day.
Each day, every borrower is re-sorted.
Every move names its rule.
A Bayesian learner tracks reply chances.
On day seven, WhatsApp replies drop.
Kairos isn't told.
By the end of day fourteen, that segment
has moved to SMS.
Learned from replies alone.
Models only suggest. Aladdin reserves the
budget and limits,
then checks every rule again at send time.
Messages go out through each channel.
Delivery and replies come back as
webhooks, and duplicates are ignored.
Your EMI was due last week. Could
you pay by Friday?
Yes, I'll pay on Friday.
Voice calls run on Sarvam agents.
Every call comes back with a disposition
and a confidence.
Below a hand-set threshold, a person
reviews it.
Replies climb a ladder: rules first, then
a small model. Still unsure?
A person decides.
People can step in at any moment. Every
action still passes Aladdin,
and lands in the audit log.
Same data in, same decisions out. And we
attack it, load it, and test it.
